sentences.text: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector: Assistance of Interest Subsidy

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector" aims to provide incentives to attract increased investments in the manufacturing sector to create more employment opportunities in Gujarat.
**Who is this for:** Industries, Business Entity; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector&quot; is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat. It aims to empower the state&#39;s dynamic large-industry sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports. Effective from October 5, 2022, to October 4, 2027, this initiative supports growth, investments, and the vision of &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat&quot; and &quot;Aatmanirbhar Bharat.&quot; The component &quot;Assistance of Interest Subsidy&quot; provides financial support to large industrial undertakings by reimbursing a portion of the interest paid on term loans. This subsidy encourages industrial growth, expansion, and diversification by reducing borrowing costs for eligible projects.

**Benefits / Assistance:**  **Category of Taluka****General****Thrust**Category 1Interest subsidy @ 7% on Term Loan for 10 years upto 1% of eFCI p.a.Interest subsidy @ 7% on Term Loan for 10 years upto 1.2% of eFCI p.a.Category 2Interest subsidy @ 7% on Term Loan for 8 years upto 1% of eFCI p.a.Interest subsidy @ 7% on Term Loan for 10 years upto 1% of eFCI p.a.Category 3Interest subsidy @ 7% on Term Loan for 6 years upto 1% of eFCI p.a.Interest subsidy @ 7% on Term Loan for 8 years upto 1% of eFCI p.a. **Note**: [List of Taluka categories.](https://imd.gujarat.gov.in/Document/I%20Branch_2297_02_Nov_2020_98.pdf)

**Exclusions / Not eligible:** - A large industrial undertaking that has received any incentive for the same Gross Fixed Capital Investment (eFCI) under any state government scheme or its agency will not be eligible unless specifically stated.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "New Investor Registration" to access the registration form. **Step-2:** Fill in the Registration Form. Click on "Submit". **Step-3:** Verify the E-mail ID using the link sent on your registered E-mail ID. **Step-4:** After verification, you will be registered successfully.  > **Post-Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "Login". **Step-2:** Enter the email address and password you used during registration. **Step-3:** Click the "Login" button to access your account. **Step-4:** Now fill in the required details and mandatory documents about your business to complete the application process.  > **Helpdesk****:** [Contact Here](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/IFP-pages/contact.jsp?pagedisp=static)
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Industries and Mines Department
